summary: Tested the 4 admin features: setup status/403, the content editor (domains + fragilities), child notes with role permissions, and the French audit log. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass. Frontend: one CRITICAL crash found and fixed. In the Contenus tab, clicking 'Défis et fragilités' (content-kind-fragility) gave a white screen: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading join)'. After the fix, every flow passed: editing domain 'social' to 'Social et liens' plus a sub-branch label plus an added sub-branch showed on the tree overview and on /domaine/social after a full reload. The reset restored 'Social et relationnel' and 4 nodes. Fragility intro edit, reload, display in the tree side panel, and reset all work. Notes: admin can add (author + date), edit ('modifiée le') and delete (confirm). The educator sees admin notes on Léo with no edit/delete buttons and can add/delete their own. Direction sees notes read-only with no note-input. Audit rows show French labels, emails, French roles and child names, and the filter works. Login hero and dashboard tree are unchanged. All test content was reset and all test notes deleted (DB checked: 0 content docs, 0 TEST notes).

minor.issue: Accepts any item_id (e.g. 'TEST_item') and an unvalidated `data: dict`. An admin typo or malformed payload (e.g. nodes as a string) gets saved and applied to every user through applyContent. That can break the tree for the whole team. Check item_id against the known ids and validate the shape (name/intro str, nodes list of {id,label,kind,note}, string lists).
No check that kind is in CONTENT_KINDS (PUT has one).
The frontend maps 'auth.logout' -> 'Déconnexion', but the backend never writes a logout audit entry.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. Switching to 'Défis et fragilités' crashed the whole app (white screen). Cause: draft was only reset in a useEffect after render, so FragilityForm rendered with the old Domain draft and called hypotheses.join on undefined. Fix: pickKind now calls setDraft(clone(first item)) before changing kind/id.

issues: A sub-branch added through the editor (5th node on Social) is drawn far from its branch. Its label appears on the far left over the Cognitif/Autonomie area instead of next to Social. Node layout positions seem fixed per index or domain, so new nodes have no proper position.

Some actions still show raw codes: auth.password_reset, auth.reset_requested, auth.session_revoked, message.send, message.thread_create, message.thread_read. Add them to ACTIONS (e.g. 'Mot de passe réinitialisé', 'Demande de réinitialisation', 'Session révoquée', 'Message envoyé', 'Conversation créée', 'Conversation lue').
Connexion rows show ' · email' (the login method), which reads oddly. Show 'par e-mail' or hide it.
Content rows show raw 'domain:social' / 'fragility:f-anxiete' instead of the French item name.
The role in the 200px person column is cut off ('(directio…', '(éduca…').

action_items: Review and keep the tester fix in ContentEditor.tsx pickKind (the crash when switching to fragilities). Also guard the forms against undefined arrays (value ?? []).
Validate content payload shape and item_id on the backend (PUT) and the kind on DELETE.
Lay out extra sub-branches added via the editor correctly on the tree (currently drawn far from their branch).
Add the missing French labels for the audit actions listed above. Show the item name instead of the 'kind:id' detail. Fix the truncated role column.
Write an auth.logout audit entry, or remove the unused label.
critical_code_review_comments: ContentEditor: draft/kind state desync (fixed). The same pattern still applies if `items.find` returns undefined for an unknown id. The `?? items[0]` fallback covers it, but only after the effect runs.

lib/content.applyContent mutates module-level DOMAINS/FRAGILITIES in place. Components only update on their next render, which works in practice, but there is no reactive state, so already-mounted views (e.g. the sidebar filter names) can show stale text until something re-renders them.
Removing or replacing sub-branch ids in the editor can orphan per-child data keyed by node id (quest_steps/levels). Consider warning the admin.
Admin can edit or delete any user's note, which matches the spec. Notes are audited via get_child (POST/PUT/DELETE), so this is fine.

rca of the issue: Crash: ContentEditor.pickKind only called setKind/setId. The draft was reset in useEffect([kind,id]), which runs after render, so the first render after switching used kind='fragility' with a Domain-shaped draft. FragilityForm then read f.hypotheses (undefined), and ListField called value.join, which threw. There was no error boundary, so the whole SPA unmounted. Repro: /admin > Contenus > click 'Défis et fragilités'. Fix: set the draft at the same time as kind/id in pickKind (applied and verified).
